policies.title: 20% dial-out sheet: leads must be dialed and updated by 8pm EST
policies.decision: All leads claimed from the 20% dial-out sheet must be dialed and the sheet updated by 8pm EST. No exceptions.

policies.title: 20% dial-out sheet: do not change filters or cherry pick
policies.decision: Reps must not change the filters on the 20% dial-out sheet or cherry-pick leads. They must take a contiguous block of leads as presented in the sheet.

policies.title: Daily dial-out list: max 75 leads, must be dialed and updated by 8 PM EST
policies.decision: For the daily dial-out list, each rep may claim up to 75 leads, must not change filters or cherry-pick, must take a block and write their full name, and must dial and update all claimed leads by 8 PM EST with no exceptions. Reps may take fewer than 75 if needed. The exact SOP must be followed.

policies.title: No-show threshold is 5 minutes from start time
policies.decision: If a lead is more than 5 minutes late to a scheduled call, they may be considered a no-show and the rep can ask them to reschedule. This applies to all call types, including triple bookings.

policies.decision: Do not send the license PDF or similar proposal documents via email. Instead, screen share the document during a live Zoom call with the applicant to review payment options.

policies.title: Non-owner at a company does not qualify unless owner approves
policies.decision: A person who is not the owner of a business does not qualify for a show unless the owner approves the business being featured. Ask to have the owner on Call 2 if they are interested.
